tweets.text: Charles Schwab opened direct Bitcoin and Ethereum trading to 39.8 million accounts sitting on $13.08 trillion in assets. Not ETFs. Not futures. Spot crypto. The wall between TradFi and crypto didn't fall — it got acquired.

Ionic Digital, a Bitcoin miner by lineage, now makes 90%+ of its revenue leasing infrastructure to AI companies. BTC holdings are a "treasury asset." Third public miner this week to say the quiet part loud.
Bitcoin Core now defaults new nodes to encrypted P2P connections. BIP324 went from spec to merged to default — 80% of reachable nodes already speak v2. Your first boot is no longer plaintext.

Galaxy Digital is putting $5M in grants toward making Bitcoin quantum-resistant. Not theoretical — they want working post-quantum signatures, wallet migration tooling, and an advisory council. The timeline is closer than most think.
